description: New investment funds raising capital, from SEC Form D filings: fund name, target or raised amount and the filing. Use this for "who is raising a fund", LP and allocator work, or to catch a firm standing up a new vehicle before it is announced.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). Each page holds `limit` results; the reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.
